Level1.Name: EnableMulticast
Level1.Description: Disable LLMNR (Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution) to prevent Responder poisoning and spoofing attacks.

Level1.Name: UseLogonCredential
Level1.Description: Disable WDigest authentication to prevent plaintext credentials from being stored in LSASS memory.

Level1.Name: EnableLUA
Level1.Description: Ensure User Account Control (UAC) is enabled to notify when programs try to make changes to the computer.

Level1.Name: ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin
Level1.Description: Set UAC to 'Always notify and prompt for consent on the secure desktop' for administrators to prevent silent elevation.

Level1.Name: NoDriveTypeAutoRun
Level1.Description: Disable Autoplay for all drives to prevent malicious executables from running automatically when media is inserted.

Level1.Name: NoLMHash
Level1.Description: Prevent Windows from storing easily cracked LAN Manager (LM) password hashes in the SAM database.

Level1.Name: DontDisplayLastUserName
Level1.Description: Do not display the last logged-on user's name on the lock screen to hide valid usernames from unauthorized users.

Level1.Name: EnableFirewall
Level1.Description: Ensure Windows Firewall is enabled for the Domain profile to protect against unauthorized network access.

Level1.Name: SMB1
Level1.Description: Disable SMBv1 protocol to prevent exploitation of legacy vulnerabilities (e.g., EternalBlue, WannaCry).

Level1.Name: LmCompatibilityLevel
Level1.Description: Set LAN Manager authentication level to NTLMv2 responses only. Refuses LM and NTLMv1 for better security.

Level1.Name: RestrictAnonymousSAM
Level1.Description: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares to prevent reconnaissance.

Level1.Name: UserAuthentication
Level1.Description: Require Network Level Authentication (NLA) for RDP connections to protect against RDP-based attacks.

Level1.Name: AlwaysInstallElevated
Level1.Description: Prevent users from installing MSI packages with elevated privileges to mitigate local privilege escalation.

Level2.Name: RunAsPPL
Level2.Description: Enable LSASS protection (RunAsPPL) to prevent memory dumping of credentials by non-protected processes.

Level2.Name: NC_AllowNetBridge_NLA
Level2.Description: Prohibit installation and configuration of Network Bridge on your DNS domain network to maintain network segmentation.

Level2.Name: Start
Level2.Description: Disable the Remote Registry service to prevent remote registry modifications by unauthorized users.

Level2.Name: DisableExceptionChainValidation
Level2.Description: Enable Structured Exception Handling Overwrite Protection (SEHOP) to mitigate stack overflow attacks.

Level2.Name: RequireSecuritySignature
Level2.Description: Enforce SMB Client Signing. Protects against NTLM relay attacks by signing all SMB traffic.

Level2.Name: RestrictDriverInstallationToAdministrators
Level2.Description: Prohibit non-administrators from installing printer drivers to mitigate PrintNightmare vulnerabilities.

Level2.Name: AllowBasic
Level2.Description: Disable Basic authentication for the WinRM client to prevent credential interception over unencrypted channels.

Level2.Name: DisableDomainCreds
Level2.Description: Prevent the storage of passwords and credentials for network authentication in the Credential Manager for increased security.

Level2.Name: EnableTranscripting
Level2.Description: Enable PowerShell Transcription Logging to record all PowerShell input and output for auditing and forensics.

Level2.Name: SafeDllSearchMode
Level2.Description: Enable Safe DLL Search Mode to prevent DLL preloading and hijacking attacks.

Level2.Name: NodeType
Level2.Description: Configure NetBIOS node type to P-node (Peer-to-Peer) to disable NetBIOS broadcasts and reduce network noise.

Level3.Name: EnableScriptBlockLogging
Level3.Description: Enable PowerShell Script Block Logging for deep visibility into obfuscated scripts and suspicious commands.

Level3.Name: DisableIPSourceRouting
Level3.Description: Drop all IP source-routed packets to prevent an attacker from dictating the path of network traffic.

Level3.Name: EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity
Level3.Description: Enable Virtualization-Based Security (VBS) to use hardware virtualization for isolated memory security.

Level3.Name: RestrictSendingNTLMTraffic
Level3.Description: Deny all outgoing NTLM traffic to remote servers, forcing the use of more secure Kerberos authentication.

Level3.Name: RequireEncryption
Level3.Description: Require SMB Encryption to protect SMB traffic from eavesdropping. Only allows connections to servers supporting SMBv3.

Level3.Name: fDisableCdm
Level3.Description: Disable client drive mapping during Remote Desktop sessions to prevent unauthorized lateral data exfiltration.
